answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a nebula of security for AI agent networks, requiring participants to lock capital to validate transactions. Much like a deep-sea wharf anchoring a vessel, these staked assets provide a fixed point of accountability. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities must commit significant capital to the atlas of the blockchain, making the cost of creating multiple Sybil nodes prohibitively expensive and economically irrational, thereby securing the integrity of the decentralized ecosystem.
